picks.rationale: Highest actionability in the pool — a major real-time AI stem-separation update that cuts latency and improves quality inside live DAW sessions, immediately usable by any producer.
picks.excerpt: zplane released PEEL STEMS 2, a major update to its real-time AI stem separation plugin for macOS and Windows that cuts processing latency and improves separation quality while working directly inside DAW sessions.

picks.rationale: A full DAW release with an LLM-driven AI Assistant that answers manual questions, generates MIDI and analyses clips on a BYOK OpenAI/Anthropic model — concrete, novel and workflow-changing.
picks.excerpt: Tracktion released Waveform 14 with an LLM-driven AI Assistant that answers questions from the manual, generates MIDI sequences and analyses clips to create complementary parts — running on a BYOK pay-as-you-go model supporting OpenAI and Anthropic APIs.

picks.rationale: A major-vendor subscription reshuffle bundling Cubase 15 AI and Ableton Live 12 Lite with a $9.99 AI-assisted starter tier — lowers the entry cost of AI songwriting for first-time creators.
picks.excerpt: Yamaha expanded its Creator Pass subscription with Cubase 15 AI, Ableton Live 12 Lite and a $9.99 Starter plan aimed at first-time creators who want AI-assisted songwriting, beat-building and idea-generation tools without DAW experience.

picks.rationale: Surfaces a wave of brand-new AI music tools built in a week — lyrics-reactive visuals, an AI songwriting assistant, a voice-recognition quiz — a concrete look at what is buildable now on music-data APIs.
picks.excerpt: Musixmatch announced the winners of its first AI-focused 'Musicathon': 523 developers built 100+ AI tools in seven days, with winning projects including Fusion Karaoke (lyrics-reactive AI visuals), Lyri (AI songwriting assistant) and SoundClash (AI voice-recognition music quiz).

picks.rationale: The most vivid, novel entry in the human-vs-AI debate — a real tribute band formed to rival the AI act Velvet Sundown, redirecting profits to musicians; frames how creators position craft against generative music.
picks.excerpt: TV writer Simon Balch formed The Bootleg Velvet Sundown, a human tribute band rivaling the AI-generated group The Velvet Sundown, pledging all profits to real musicians 'whose work AI stole in the first place.'
